call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: After-Hours Multiple Compression (-18.1%) vs Q4 Guidance Optics
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Bill, Q3 was a clean beat across revenue, cRPO, and FCF margins, yet the stock is down 18% aftermarket to $122.95. Is the market overreacting to Q4 subscription guidance ($4.16B mid) being a hair below whisper numbers, or are you seeing any softening in new customer pipeline conversion?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Chairman & CEO Bill McDermott stated unequivocally that the pipeline is the strongest in ServiceNow's history. The business generated 19 transactions over $5 million in net new ACV, up 135% YoY. The Q4 guide represents standard executive prudence on year-end deal timing. ServiceNow is operating as a 'Rule of 57' enterprise with no compute or capital constraints, and the after-hours price reaction is completely disconnected from business reality.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: AI ACV Target Raised to $1.7B & Agentic Workflow Production Ramp
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Gina, raising the year-end AI ACV target to $1.7 billion—up 70% from your initial target—is impressive. Where is this incremental demand originating, and how does the monetization transition from Pro Plus seats to autonomous agent consumption?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: President & CFO Gina Mastantuono explained that customer adoption has shifted from assistant-based seat add-ons to autonomous agentic workflows. Production consumption of AI agents is up more than 13x year-over-year. Through Action Fabric and AI Passport, ServiceNow meters and governs every agent action, enabling the company to capture value on compute, governance, and workflow outcomes.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Control Tower Alliance with OpenAI & NVIDIA Governance Layer
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Bill, could you speak to the Control Tower Alliance announced today with OpenAI, NVIDIA, and AWS? How does ServiceNow ensure it remains the central control plane rather than being commoditized by underlying model providers?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Bill McDermott emphasized that model providers like OpenAI and Anthropic are powerful engines of intelligence, but enterprises cannot deploy autonomous agents without governance, audit trails, and kill switches. ServiceNow provides the essential 'Super Intelligence Control Tower'—the single harness that connects reasoning to governed enterprise action across software and silicon, creating an unassailable moat.
